QuestInfo.name: [11th Anniversary] A Budding Friendship
QuestInfo.0: It's a bountiful year for bellflowers, yet Momma Bellflower seems worried. Ask Momma bellflower about growing bellflowers!
QuestInfo.1:
Momma Bellflower says that the year has brought so many new budding baby bellflowers that there aren't enough people to look after all of them. Help Momma Bellflower look after the buds growing in Bellflower Pots in exchange for a thank-you gift. 

#bTime required to grow a bellflower: 20 minutes
You can receive up to 5 gifts each day 
Event ends : 6/1/2016 on 00:00:00

* A growing bellflower will restart its growth cycle when you log off.#k
QuestInfo.2: You hope your efforts are putting Momma Bellflower's mind at ease.
